Dulquer Salmaan posts heartfelt birthday wish for father Mammootty

Actor Dulquer Salmaan posted a heartfelt birthday message for his father, Malayalam superstar Mammootty, on his 75th birthday. Salmaan referred to his father as his 'safest place in the world'. Other members of the film industry also sent birthday wishes to Mammootty.
